title: ExamDesk: Results and Evaluation
context: Exam cells take attendance, distribute scripts to evaluators, catch copying and publish ranked results.
input: Students (roll, marks per subject); answer strings; script bundles.

milestones.title: Duplicate attendance
milestones.requirement: Roll numbers marked present twice (count array).

milestones.title: Grace marks
milestones.requirement: Fewest grace 'units' (1, 2, 5 marks) to reach the pass mark exactly (coin change).

milestones.title: Marks in any roll range
milestones.requirement: Prefix sums of marks; totals for roll ranges in O(1).

milestones.title: Copying check
milestones.requirement: Longest common subsequence of two answer strings as a similarity score.

milestones.title: Evaluator load
milestones.requirement: Split script bundles (in order) among 3 evaluators minimising the maximum load.

milestones.title: Rank list
milestones.requirement: Total desc, then maths desc (multi-key comparator).
